page_title: NIC 3-2 REN | Nice v Rennes 03/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Evann Guessand goes off and Dante (Nice) comes on.
90+3' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) earns the yellow card.
90+3' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is booked.
90+2' Pablo Rosario (Nice) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Jerome Brisard sends him off the pitch.
90+2' Marcin Bulka (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The game is interrupted now, Marcin Bulka (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
89' Half-chance! Antoine Mendy (Nice) plays a pass into the box, but Steve Mandanda reacts well to snuff out the attack.
88' The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
87' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
86' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Leo Ostigard (Rennes) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Nice, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
86' Here is a change. Sofiane Diop is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
85' It will be a substitution. Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) is ready to enter the pitch as Jordan James walks off.
80' Nice will take a corner kick.
79' Great touch by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) as he received a precise pass on the edge of the box. His powerful shot bounced off the goalkeeper’s gloves and hit the post.
77' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

76' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
74' A player from Nice commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Rennes will take a free kick.
71' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Badredine Bouanani will be replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
70' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde walks off the pitch and Pablo Rosario (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
68' Seko Fofana (Rennes) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
66' Jerome Brisard shows the yellow card to Sofiane Diop (Nice) for a heavy challenge.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Seko Fofana (Rennes) is brought on as a substitute for Mikayil Faye.
63' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Rennes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Nice are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) for a tough tackle.
61' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) plays a through ball but overhits it.
60' The free kick is taken by Badredine Bouanani (Nice), but ball is cleared.
60' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Rennes is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Nice in a dangerous position.
58' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
57' The linesman raises his flag. Badredine Bouanani (Nice) is adjudged offside.
57' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
57' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
56' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Steve Mandanda pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Nice have a corner.
56' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
55' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
54' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul after Jordan James (Rennes) hacks down one of his opponents. Nice earn a free kick.
53' What a big chance! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.

51' A cross by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.

51' Jordan James (Rennes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Nice will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
49' 3 - 2 Goal! Adrien Truffert (Rennes) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 3:2.

49' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
46' Jorge Sampaoli makes a switch. Amine Gouiri is coming on in place of Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' 3 - 1 It's 3:1! Evann Guessand feeds Gaetan Laborde (Nice) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.

45+4' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
45+1' Evann Guessand (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Melvin Bard (Nice) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Melvin Bard (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
43' Nice are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
41' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
40' A player from Rennes pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Nice have been awarded a free kick.
39' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
39' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
37' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call. Rennes have a free kick.
36' An attempted cross from Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is cleared.
34' 2 - 1 Goal! Steve Mandanda makes a huge mistake and Sofiane Diop (Nice) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
34' Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is able to continue to play.
32' Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Ludovic Blas puts a cross into the box and finds Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the right post. He makes it 1:1.
25' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick is awarded to Rennes.
21' Melvin Bard (Nice) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
20' A player from Nice commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Rennes get a free kick.
17' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
16' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul. Rennes win a free kick.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Evann Guessand (Nice) takes a short pass from Tanguy Ndombele in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
10' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jerome Brisard ignores the protests.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gaetan Laborde (Nice) heads on.
9' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Steve Mandanda, who pulls off a stunning save!
9' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Jordan James (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Marcin Bulka easily deals with the threat. Now Rennes have a corner.
5' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Rennes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick to Nice.
4' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jerome Brisard saw the whole situation. Nice have a free kick.
2' Evann Guessand (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
